commit_message:
[Tracy] Bump Tracy to 0.15 (#25241)

Bumps Tracy from wolfpld/tracy@5479a42 (a post-v0.11.1 dev snapshot) to
[v0.15.0](https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy/releases/tag/v0.15.0)
(wolfpld/tracy@f2a4f25).
Upstream changelog:
[NEWS](https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy/blob/v0.15.0/NEWS). Notable
Tracy changes:
- Tracy now also Ships Prebuilt binaries for Linux and Mac (relates to
#19841)
- Loading traces from a URL in the web viewer (relates to #11957)
- Sections and a C API for them (relates to #16051)
- Messages: severity levels and filtering in the GUI
- Bugfixes, e.g. we encountered some use-after-free on Android

Changes apart from the actual bump:
- Message severities: IREE_TRACE_MESSAGE levels now map to Tracy
severities.Colors are unchanged.
- Lock events: the release is now recorded before the unlock
(iree_tracing_mutex_after_unlock → iree_tracing_mutex_before_unlock),
matching upstream. prevents anohter Thread's lock being recorded before
an unlock.
- TracyClient CMake target: IREE sets TRACY_ENABLE ON, because Tracy now
defaults it to OFF. Otherwise the exported target is empty for anything
linking it.
- No system zstd needed for iree-tracy-capture: it's built from source,
and the libzstd-devel installs in the packaging scripts are gone.
- Capture-tool dependencies: capstone moves to 6.0.0-Alpha11 and PPQSort
to 1.0.6, with upstream's patches.

Closes #21371

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit_message:
[CI] Add LLVMCPU aarch64 and riscv64 lit tests only if LLVM has the target (#25234)

The tests
- early_data_tiling.mlir, early_data_tiling_convolution.mlir,
early_data_tiling_dynamic.mlir, added in
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/24969
- roundeven_native.mlir, added in
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/25219 (also riscv64), compile for
aarch64.

byo_llvm.sh builds LLVM with only the X86 target, so iree-compile stops
with "createTargetMachine(...) failed" and the tests fail
linux_x64_clang_byollvm job.

Add these tests in the same way as
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/25221: CMake adds them only if
iree_compiler_targeting_iree_arch() is true for their architecture.

Theaarch64 and riscv64 RUN lines move into *_aarch64.mlir and
*_riscv64.mlir files, which copy the IR.

ci-extra: linux_x64_clang_byollvm

---------

Signed-off-by: Tobias Fuchs <fuchs@roofline.ai>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
name: Tag candidate release
